title: Application Rates for Scheme that Exempts Persons with Disabilities from Paying COE Premiums and Additional Registration Fees for Vehicles
what_it_is: Application Rates for Scheme that Exempts Persons with Disabilities from Paying COE Premiums and Additional Registration Fees for Vehicles

sections.label: DPS applications decline and review
sections.summary: DPS applications fell from 93 in 2015 to 20 in 2023, and the scheme will be monitored and reviewed, with the last review in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The number of applications for DPS has steadily declined from 93 in 2015 to 20 in 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As we continue to push ahead with our efforts to make public transport accessible to all persons with disabilities, we will monitor the take-up of the scheme and review the need for DPS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: The last review of DPS was actually conducted in 2017 and, in that exercise, we updated the income ceiling for the scheme so that we can keep up with the changes in per capita incomes of Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: And as I have mentioned in my main reply, what we commit to do is to make sure that we review DPS.

sections.label: DPS review and means-testing
sections.summary: DPS concerns persons with disabilities and caregivers, and is being reviewed within a holistic transport ecosystem review, with means-tested tiering kept to current PCHI levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: In my private exchanges with Member Mr Ong Hua Han, as well as other persons with disabilities and caregivers, I understand that DPS is a matter of concern to the community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: But as I mentioned in my main reply, we do need the means-tested tiering to keep up with the PCHI of today's levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: And as I mentioned earlier in my supplementary reply to Mr Ong Hua Han, we are reviewing DPS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: We understand that we need to keep the scheme relevant, but in the context of our more holistic review of the entire transport ecosystem for persons with disabilities and the caregivers.
